万兽（万兽（第22页）“什么东西？”萧炎有些疑惑，很想找个博学的老前辈问问，但戒指里面的老爷爷显然是没有睡醒，不可能给他解答这个问题。“感觉像是魔兽一族的东西。”萧炎细细感应了一下其中的气息，发现那气息和魔核散发的气息有几分相似。随着骨片的飞出，池水也瞬间冷静了下来，不再沸腾的同时，颜色也变回了清澈透亮。“不管了，先收起来！”想了想，萧炎准备将其收好之后，回头找薰儿问问，她爱看古书，说不定会知道一些消息。然而，骨片入手的刹那，萧炎的手掌陡然传来阵阵被火焰灼伤的疼痛。那猩红纹路竟如活物般蠕动，化作一缕血红色的火苗顺着经脉窜入体内，气旋中的斗气瞬间沸腾起来。“嘶——”萧炎倒抽一口凉气甩手欲扔，骨片却像被黏在手掌上一般，纹丝不动。这是，火焰？萧炎的心头猛然一跳。旋即，斗之气旋内的斗气倾巢而出，将那一缕火焰包裹了起来，下意识的将其送入功法《火元诀》的运转路线之中。即便是这么一缕小火苗，其中的炽热能量，也远超萧炎的想象，体内的经脉瞬间就被灼烧地扭曲起来，炽热之感，充斥在身体的每一处，萧炎下意识的跳进了池水中。池水瞬间就沸腾了！但萧炎却是觉得稍微舒服了一些。经脉中的小火苗，不断地幻化出各种兽形，带着些许古老的威压，让萧炎的灵魂都因此而微微颤抖。斗气消耗得飞快，萧炎不得不从纳戒取出了一些恢复斗气的丹药，一把塞入口中，顷刻之间，将其炼化为斗气，支撑着体内斗气的运转。即便如此，那看似弱小至极的火苗，也依旧拥有极为可怕的破坏力，萧炎哪还不知道，这玩意就算不是异火，也绝对算得上是一种极为强悍的火焰了！但这东西进了他体内，似乎就没准备出去，要么他炼化火焰，修为有所增长，要么他被火焰炼化，成为火焰的载体。就在萧炎焦头烂额，水池中的水液蒸发成氤氲水雾时，萧炎的手指上，漆黑的古朴纳戒，突然闪烁了一下。一缕森白色的火焰，陡然涌现！伴随着那道森白色火焰的出现，一股冰冷刺骨的寒意，席卷了整个山洞，萧炎体内的那一缕火苗，瞬间收敛了温度，极为温顺的接受着萧炎的炼化。与此同时，一道强悍的灵魂力量，陡然从纳戒中涌出，携带着一缕灰芒，飞入萧炎体内的斗之气旋中。“鲁莽的小子，虽然只是一道刚诞生的本源火种，但毕竟也是异火，竟然什么准备都不做，就敢沾染！若非老夫感应到异火的气息苏醒过来，你今日必死无疑！”苍老的声音，带着浓郁的斥责味道，在萧炎的耳畔响起。而听到那耳朵并不熟悉，脑子却不觉得陌生的苍老身影，萧炎心头浮现出浓浓的喜悦之情：“太好了，是药老，我有救了！”

> Chapter 11 Ten Thousand Beasts (Page 1)
Ten Thousand Beasts (Ten Thousand Beasts (page 22) "What is it?" Xiao Yan was a little confused and wanted to find a knowledgeable old man to ask, but the old man in the ring was obviously not awake yet, so it was impossible to answer this question for him. "It feels like something from the Warcraft clan." Xiao Yan sensed the breath carefully and found that the breath was somewhat similar to the breath emitted by the magic core. As the bone fragments flew out, the water in the pool instantly After a while, he calmed down and stopped boiling. At the same time, the color returned to clear and translucent. "No matter, put it away first!" After thinking about it, Xiao Yan turned to Xun'er to ask, she liked reading ancient books, maybe she would know some information. However, the moment the bone fragment was taken, Xiao Yan's palm suddenly felt the pain of being burned by the flames. The scarlet lines squirmed like a living thing and turned into a wisp of blood. The flames rushed into the body along the meridians, and the fighting energy in the vortex boiled instantly. "Hiss—" Xiao Yan gasped and threw his hand, but the bone fragment seemed to be stuck to his hand, motionless. Is this a flame? Xiao Yan's heart jumped suddenly. Immediately, the fighting energy in the vortex rushed out, wrapped up the wisp of flame, and subconsciously sent it into the operation path of the "Fire Origin Art". Even in such a small flame, the fiery energy was far beyond Xiao Yan's imagination. The meridians in his body were instantly distorted by burning, and the feeling of heat filled every part of his body. Xiao Yan subconsciously jumped into the water. The water boiled instantly! But Xiao Yan felt a little more comfortable. The small flames in the meridians continued to transform into various animal shapes, with a bit of ancient pressure. Yan's soul trembled slightly because of this. The Dou Qi was consumed quickly, and Xiao Yan had to take out some elixirs to restore Dou Qi from Najie, put it into his mouth, and instantly refined it into Dou Qi to support the movement of Dou Qi in his body. Even so, the seemingly weak flames still had extremely terrifying destructive power. Xiao Yan didn't know that even if this thing was not a strange fire, it was definitely a weapon. It was an extremely powerful flame! But it seemed that it was not ready to come out after refining the flame, or he was refined by the flame and became the carrier of the flame. When Xiao Yan was in a state of panic and the water in the pool evaporated into mist, the dark ancient ring suddenly flickered on his finger. A wisp of dark white flame suddenly appeared! The appearance of forest white flames and a biting chill swept through the entire cave. The flames in Xiao Yan's body instantly cooled down and accepted Xiao Yan's refining extremely docilely. At the same time, a powerful soul power suddenly surged out from the Najie, carrying a wisp of gray light and flew into the vortex of fighting within Xiao Yan's body. "Reckless boy, although it is just a newly born source of fire. After all, it is also a strange fire, and you dare to get involved without making any preparations! If I hadn't sensed the breath of the strange fire and woke up, you would have died today!" The old voice sounded in Xiao Yan's ears. When he heard the old figure who was unfamiliar to his ears but not familiar to his mind, Xiao Yan felt a strong sense of joy in his heart: "Great, it's Yao Lao, I'm saved!"
